Alex (Sales): Quick sync — ACME wants an air-gapped POC next month. They asked about offline bundle delivery, upgrade cadence they can expect, and what we require from their side for activation. Ping @Mira for packaging constraints.

Mira (Solutions Eng): Saw the ask. Short version: we can deliver signed, chunked bundles + delta patches, but their infra needs a jumpbox + file transfer mechanism. Typical offline cadence: full bundle every 90 days + optional security hotfixes between windows.

ACME IT: 90 days is a bit long for security updates. Can you do monthly security hotfixes? Also what about model weights size — we have limited disk on edge nodes (~200GB).

Mira (Solutions Eng): Monthly hotfixes are possible but treated as out-of-band patches (SOW or premium SLA). For model sizing we can ship quantized variants — down to ~6-12GB per model depending on quantization. We can also split the runtime vs weights into separate artifacts so you only update weights.

Owen (Infra PM): Implementation notes: we sign bundles with our PKI (cosign), provide the SBOM, and produce a delta manifest so clients can apply smaller patches. Transport options: scp over jumpbox, S3-compatible signed URLs delivered on media, or physical media (secure courier) for highly restricted sites. Need to know allowed egress/ingress ports for validation checks.

ACME IT: We cannot open outbound at all from the subnet. Signed URLs won't work. Jumpbox + scp is OK. For emergency hotfixes we prefer an automated pull from an internal staging repo — can your bundle installer pull from an internal artifactory?

Mira (Solutions Eng): Yes — installer supports pulling from an internal registry/artifactory. We'll provide an OCI-compatible image and a tarball option. Installer checks signature locally. Example verification command we run on device:```bash
cosign verify --key /opt/redwood/keys/pub.pem registry.acme/internal/redwood-bundle:20260301
```

Tara (Legal): Heads up on licensing: customers in this tier require a signed MSA + addendum for air-gapped distribution. Also need export compliance check for certain model weights. We'll need their org's EIN and a completed distributor questionnaire.

Alex (Sales): Noted. ACME — we'll send the addendum and the security questionnaire. On pricing: if they want monthly hotfixes and 24/7 accelerated patch delivery, that pushes them into "Dedicated Airgap" pricing. Standard offline POC pricing covers quarterly bundles + up to 2 emergency patches.

ACME IT: What's the SLA window for an emergency patch under the premium option?

Alex (Sales): Premium SLA = 72-hour turnaround for validated patch + signed bundle delivery. If they need <24h turnaround we have a separate enterprise support SKU.

ACME IT: 72h is workable. What about certificate rotation for long-lived private keys? We have strict rotation (30 days).

Owen (Infra PM): We support short-lived keys — we can generate signed manifests with expiring timestamps and provide a key-rotation script that runs via your jumpbox. For HSM/KMS integration: we support wrapping keys with customer KMS in the Private deployment option, but that requires on-prem key material and an initial handshake during provisioning.

Mira (Solutions Eng): Operational notes for installers on isolated networks:
- offline bundle includes: runtime.tar.gz, weights-part-*.tar.gz, sbom.json, signature.sig
- installer verifies signature + sbom before applying
- delta/patch manifest lists file-level diffs to apply smaller deltas
- we recommend a staging node that mirrors updates first

ACME IT: Can you provide an example manifest format? We want to script validation on our side.
